meta.siteTitle: WebRadio — Internet radio for Windows and Linux
meta.siteDescription: WebRadio is an open-source internet radio player for Windows and Linux: worldwide station search, an FFmpeg audio pipeline, plugins, themes and Discord Rich Presence.

hero.subtitle: WebRadio combines worldwide station search, favourites and a customisable interface in one open-source application for Windows and Linux. Extend it with plugins and themes – or build your own.

features.title: Listen. Customise. Extend.
features.description: The features below are implemented in the WebRadio desktop application – not just planned.

stations.title: Stations from all over the world
stations.body: Search internet radio stations through the Radio Browser API and filter by country and genre. Favourites and history bring back what you listened to recently.

audio.title: Native audio pipeline
audio.body: Streams run through FFmpeg, are processed as PCM and output through an AudioWorklet pipeline – no HTML audio element as the core playback solution.

plugins.title: Extensible through plugins
plugins.body: The plugin system understands manifests, capabilities, permissions, lifecycle, storage, navigation and UI extensions. Capabilities are checked by the core.

themes.title: Themes for your interface
themes.body: Themes are based on CSS variables and theme packages. Bundled examples include default, dark and neon; custom theme packages are possible.

player.title: One player for every source
player.body: The unified player brings radio and integrations such as YouTube together behind one API for playback, titles, artwork and provider status.

presence.title: Favourites, history & rich presence
presence.body: Saved stations, recent listening and Discord rich presence with the current station and track title. Updates follow the stable, beta or alpha channel.

listeners.title: For listeners
listeners.body: Search stations, save favourites and listen – no development environment needed. Windows installers and Linux packages are available in the GitHub releases.

developers.title: For developers
developers.body: An Electron/React application with separate core, player, plugin and UI layers. The plugin SDK documents manifests, capabilities and public APIs.

creators.title: For creators & modders
creators.body: Build your own plugins, themes and integrations. Extensions request capabilities; they cannot change security boundaries themselves.

opensource.body: WebRadio's source code is licensed under Apache-2.0. Bugs and suggestions belong in the GitHub issues; please report security issues through the security policy, not publicly.
